text:
devon: Customer onboards -> suddenly seeing ~3-4x p99 in NA-west starting ~08:12 UTC, requests silently routed to eu-west and failing with intermittent 401s. ticket #INC-8472.

alex.k: Ugh. Any logs? Are these automatic failovers or manual region pins?

maria_s: We have autospill configured for NA-west when queue depth > 2000 requests. That should kick in. Noted that the routing header was X-Region: na-west but payload shows X-Routed-From: na-west -> eu-west.

devon: Error samples from customer: 503 then 401 after retry. They see higher egress cost too. Pasted logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:13:02Z] req_id=abc123 region=na-west route=spillover target=eu-west status=503 latency=1200ms
[2026-03-15T08:13:04Z] req_id=abc123 target=eu-west auth=failed token_scope_mismatch status=401
```

sam.l: Looks like token audience mismatch when hitting eu-west. We recently rotated signing keys and there is an audience claim that includes region-scoped issuer. If routed cross-region token validation may fail.

devon: Customer says their client pins region header to na-west. We should not override unless capacity overflow. But overflow happened and routing code did fallback without injecting cross-region token exchange.

alex.k: Repro steps I used: 
1) run 10k warmup in na-west to saturate warm pools.
2) send bursts of 200 concurrent curl requests with header X-Region: na-west.
3) watch routing logs.

curl snippet: 
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Region: na-west" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"hello"}'
```

maria_s: When failover happens we should perform a token exchange (STS) or attach a region-agnostic proxy token. Currently fallback path sets X-Routed-From but does NOT do exchange. That's the auth gap.

oncall-bot: alert: na-west queue-depth crossed threshold -> autospillover enabled at 08:12:41 UTC (policy: queue>1800).

devon: Customer also reported billing; they saw eu-west egress billed at higher rate. That makes sense if requests spilled across regions. Need to notify billing for audit.

sam.l: Short-term mitigation: disable auto-failover for that customer's project (we can pin to na-west) and open a rollback for the routing change. Also, we should backfill logs for all req_ids with X-Routed-From header.

alex.k: Long-term: update failover path to do one of:
- STS exchange to get region-acceptable token, OR
- attach a short-lived cross-region fallback token issued by control plane, OR
- preserve original region and only route to compatible model replicas (same auth domain).

maria_s: I can PR a patch to routing layer that triggers an internal auth exchange before switching target region. Will include unit test for token audience and integration test that simulates a 401 post-failover.

devon: Repro for engineering: I uploaded a small harness to S3: s3://rwd-debug/na-west-failover/harness-20260315.zip (contains locustfile + token-mocker). Steps in README: run locust against na-west control plane, set failure_mode=queue-surge.

support-bot: Created support case INC-8472 and CC'd billing and security.

sam.l: For immediate customer-facing response: apologize, explain we detected automatic cross-region routing that caused auth mismatches and billing detours, offer to pin region for 72 hours and credit the egress delta while we fix.

devon: Thanks. Action items: 
- maria_s: PR routing auth-exchange (ETA 24h)
- alex.k: collect full req_id traces + handoff to billing (ETA 2h)
- sam.l: customer comms + temporary pin (ETA 30m)
- oncall-bot: keep queue alerting window open and post if queue drops below 500.

maria_s: Starting branch now. I'll paste failing unit test here shortly.

alex.k: Collected traces for 1200 req_ids, uploading to /mnt/debug/INC-8472/traces.tar.gz

devon: Great. Closing loop after PR merged. :thumbsup:
